models.label: int8+fp16 (small, ~65 MB)
models.description: Weight-only int8 backbone (m.bb.*, m.squeeze_module.*) + fp16 decoder, materialised to fp32. 68.5 MB, 0 pixels flip vs the teacher on the repo test images. Default: smallest artifact with no 0.5-threshold flips.

models.label: fp16 weights (~94 MB)
models.description: Weight-only fp16 storage, fp32 compute (previously shipped as c5_best.onnx). Byte-identical to that artifact.

models.label: fp32 full (~184 MB)
models.description: Phase-1 fp32 export of BiRefNet_lite at 512x512 (the teacher, no quantisation). Largest download; reference quality.
